claim: The Japan Braille Library is a real library in Tokyo, founded in 1940.

check.quote: Japan Braille Library (日本点字図書館, Nippon Tenji Toshokan) is a special private library in Tokyo, Japan, serving individuals who are unable to read standard printed material. ... November 10, 1940, Japan library for the blind is founded in Tokyo by a blind man, Kazuo Honma (1915-2003).
